thread:
julie.ops: FYI new hire Asha Kapoor slated to start 2024-12-02. She uploaded a Canadian passport that expires 2024-12-14 (12 days after start). Vendor also flagged a discrepancy on SSN entry during background intake (candidate used dashes). Need plan for completing I-9 remotely and getting BG consent corrected before granting access. @ryan.recruiter @tony-it

ryan.recruiter: Quick Q  can we accept the passport for Section 2 if its valid on the start date even though its close to expiry? Also Asha prefers not to visit an office.

julie.ops: Yes  as long as the document is unexpired on the date we complete Section 2. For remote folks we allow an "authorized agent" (notary or HR rep) to sign Section 2. We must capture the agents printed name, title, address, and signature.

julie.ops: For BG  vendor needs a corrected signed consent form with SSN entered consistently (no spaces/dashes). We emailed Asha a fresh link. If BG completes after start we restrict sensitive access until cleared.

asha.kapoor: I can go to a local notary next week. Can you send exact instructions so Im sure the notary fills everything you need?

julie.ops: Pasteable note for candidate (send this):

```
Hi Asha  thanks. Because youre remote you can have a local notary or authorized agent complete Section 2 of Form I-9 on or before 2024-12-02. Ask the agent to include: full printed name, title, company/firm, business address, date of verification, signature, and a contact phone or email. Please upload a clear scan or photo of the signed Section 2 to our secure onboarding portal: https://redwood-secure-intake.example/. Keep originals for your records.

If you prefer vendor-assisted verification we can book a proctor through our notary partner (drop a note) and reimburse any standard notary fee.
```

tony-it: Logistics: we will ship the laptop with standard encryption and create an MDM profile. Network and admin access will be disabled until BG returns green and we verify I-9. We can provision basic Slack/email on Day 1 via invite-only SSO link.

ryan.recruiter: I'll chase Asha for the corrected consent (should be a one-click sign). Also following up with GoodCheck to flag the SSN formatting issue so future candidates get clearer guidance.

i9-bot: Reminder: Section 2 must be completed by an authorized agent on or before the employees first day. Upload link: https://redwood-secure-intake.example/ (3-day window recommended).

julie.ops: If the notary upload looks incomplete (missing agent contact or illegible name) escalate to me. We can also accept a notarized Letter of Inspection from our vendor partner if the local agent refuses to attach an ID copy.

asha.kapoor: Thanks everyone  Ill pick a notary this week and sign the corrected BG consent now.

ryan.recruiter: Great  Ill monitor BG and confirm with Tony when its safe to enable VPN/admin roles. ETA on BG re-run: usually 24-72h after corrected consent.
